Subject: INTERNAL: ACME retro credit — margin calc and passback mechanics

Laura / Neha — forwarding Jessica's ask. A few specifics we need to nail down before we share:

1) Margin waterfall: Redwood list price -> private-offer discount -> reseller commission -> distributor uplift -> net passback. For this account the private-offer discount was an effective 28% list-price reduction; reseller commission was 8% of list price; distributor uplift (for invoicing) was negotiated at 3% flat. We need to show the math and the net-dollar retro credit.

2) SKU alignment: the marketplace SKU naming sometimes diverges from our internal product names (reserved-capacity vs. token-metered SKU). If we show equivalence we should include the SKU ID and the internal Product ID column. The mapping file draft is redwood_sku_mapping_v3.csv.

3) Eligibility window: Jessica asked for May aggregates. Confirm we only apply retro credits for usage in May 2027 (UTC). If MarketplaceOps needs a rolling window or different granularity we should note it.

4) Evidence format for Marketplace: they prefer a short CSV (sku, start_date, end_date, quantity, usage_units, billed_amount) + a single-page narrative PDF. Keep file names explicit.

I've attached margin_calc_draft.xlsx (internal) — it has a suggested passback calculation with both list-price and net-of-discount views. Laura please review the uplift percentages and confirm legal sign-off owner. Neha please confirm you can produce the May aggregates with the columns Marketplace wants.

Thanks — Marcus
